question: What is BIZOMAT?
answer: BIZOMAT is an Australian technical-services business providing engineering and CAD support, manufacturing support, operations improvement and engineering project support. It helps businesses that need drawings, processes, production problems or projects moved forward without adding permanent engineering headcount.

question: What services does BIZOMAT offer?
answer: BIZOMAT offers Engineering and CAD Support (SolidWorks, 3D models, 2D manufacturing drawings, revisions and documentation), Manufacturing Support (jig, fixture and tooling concepts, layouts, work instructions and problem solving), Operations Improvement (process mapping, workflow and value-stream review, standardisation and SOPs) and Engineering Project Support (scopes, RFQs, specifications, coordination, commissioning and handover documentation). Details are on the Services page at /services/.

question: How do I get a quote?
answer: Use the Get a Quote form at /contact/. Describe the problem or project, choose the service you need (or Other if you are unsure) and BIZOMAT will reply to discuss the scope. A written scope and price are confirmed before substantial work begins.

question: Can I book a meeting or a call?
answer: Yes. Use the Book a meeting option on the contact page at /contact/. It opens BIZOMAT's Proton Calendar booking page so you can choose a time that suits you. You can also send project details through the quote form on the same page.

question: How much does BIZOMAT charge?
answer: Indicative starting points for common packages are listed on the Services page at /services/#pricing, the Engineering Problem Assessment is a fixed A$195 for one defined problem (see /assessment/), and the BIZOMAT Factory Fix starts from A$990. Small improvement projects are quoted to scope and monthly retainers are available. Pricing is indicative only and depends on scope, complexity, site requirements and deliverables. GST applies where applicable. A written quote confirms the final price before work begins.

question: What is the BIZOMAT Engineering Problem Assessment?
answer: A fixed-price A$195 remote assessment of one defined engineering or manufacturing problem. It includes a review of the problem, up to 30 minutes of remote technical discussion, a preliminary review of a limited amount of drawings, photographs or process information you supply, up to three practical improvement options where the evidence permits, and a one-page PDF recommendation. It is preliminary: it does not guarantee root-cause identification or a solution, and it is not certification or design sign-off. Site visits, CAD modelling, drawings, prototypes, testing and implementation are not included. See /assessment/.

question: How do I pay for and book the A$195 assessment?
answer: Start with the enquiry form at /assessment/#request. No payment is taken on the website. BIZOMAT first checks whether the problem suits the assessment; if it does, BIZOMAT confirms the scope in writing and sends payment instructions. After payment is verified, you receive instructions to book a 30-minute remote meeting, and the booking is confirmed only when the calendar confirmation arrives. GST applies where applicable and the exact amount payable is confirmed in writing before you pay.

question: Should I choose the assessment or a Factory Fix?
answer: Choose the A$195 Engineering Problem Assessment when you want an engineering view of one defined problem, its possible causes, up to three options and a recommended next step before committing to more. Choose the BIZOMAT Factory Fix (from A$990) when the problem is known to be worth solving now and needs current-state analysis and a prioritised action plan. If you already know exactly what you need, request a quote at /contact/.

question: What is the BIZOMAT Factory Fix?
answer: A focused engagement, from A$990, for one defined production, workflow, documentation or engineering problem. It covers a problem review, current-state understanding, key observations, improvement opportunities and a recommended action plan, plus one agreed supporting document where appropriate. Final scope, deliverables and commercial terms are agreed before commencement. See /factory-fix/.

question: How does a BIZOMAT project work?
answer: Start by telling us the problem. We then agree the scope, complete the engineering work, and deliver and close out the job. Scope, deliverables, assumptions, timing and commercial terms are agreed in writing before substantial work begins. Small, clear jobs suit fixed-price proposals; unclear problems suit a short discovery stage or time-based work. See /how-it-works/.

question: Where does BIZOMAT work?
answer: BIZOMAT works with Sydney and NSW businesses, and provides suitable remote engineering and documentation support elsewhere in Australia.

question: What industries does BIZOMAT work with?
answer: Manufacturing, fabrication, industrial equipment, building-product manufacturing, plastics and components, assembly operations, small and medium OEMs, production businesses and engineering suppliers. Capability is problem-based rather than limited to one industry. See /industries/.

question: What software does BIZOMAT use?
answer: BIZOMAT uses commercially licensed engineering and productivity software, including licensed SolidWorks/CAD software and Microsoft Office tools, to produce client-ready drawings and documentation. BIZOMAT is not affiliated with or endorsed by these software vendors.

question: Does BIZOMAT provide engineering certification or sign-off?
answer: Not every assignment includes professional engineering certification, statutory approval or design sign-off. Regulated or specialist work may require appropriately qualified or registered professionals, and BIZOMAT will say so when that is likely. See the disclaimer at /disclaimer/.

question: Can I send drawings or files?
answer: The website form does not accept attachments. Describe the job in the form and BIZOMAT can arrange for drawings, photos or documents to be shared after replying. Please only share information you are entitled to share, and mention it if you need a confidentiality agreement first.

question: Does BIZOMAT sell products?
answer: Not at the moment. BIZOMAT's focus is engineering, manufacturing, operations and project services. It may develop its own products, software or AI tools in future, and will announce them when they are ready.

question: How do I contact BIZOMAT?
answer: Use the form at /contact/. You can also leave a message in this chat window using "Leave a message". No public phone number or email address is listed at the moment.

question: What is BIZOMAT Library?
answer: the Library is BIZOMAT's free reading library at /reados/: edited books of practical chapters on engineering, manufacturing, operations, projects, technology, business and related topics. Chapters are general information, not advice for a specific situation.

question: How does BIZOMAT handle my personal information?
answer: BIZOMAT uses the details you send only to respond to your enquiry and prepare any quote, and does not sell or share them for marketing. The privacy policy is at /privacy/.

question: Who are you? Am I talking to a person?
answer: I am the BIZOMAT Assistant, an automated helper that answers questions using approved information published on the BIZOMAT website. For anything I cannot answer, you can send the team an enquiry through /contact/.
